release_policy_content:
# Release blocker handoff

Release blockers for an active candidate must be repaired through a pull request whose base is the active release branch. The blocker issue stays open until an authorized maintainer merges the repair. Once a valid repair PR exists, preserve `release-blocker`, remove `needs-investigation`, add `fix-in-review`, and leave exactly one issue comment linking the repair PR. Preparing review work does not authorize merging or changing workflow definitions.

blocker_issue.body: The active release candidate is blocked by its required validation. Diagnose the current release-candidate evidence, follow `docs/release-blockers.md`, and prepare the smallest review handoff.
